sources.content: The plimsby-mirror image runs Plimsby, a pull through cache for container registries. It is built on alpine:3.19 and runs as user plimsby with user ID 1200. The mirror serves the registry API on port 5000 and stores cached layers under /var/lib/plimsby, which should be a volume. The entrypoint is /usr/bin/plimsby serve. The image is about 18 MB compressed and contains no package manager after the build. Image tags follow the Plimsby release version, such as 2.4.1.

Environment. PLIMSBY_UPSTREAM sets the registry to mirror and defaults to registry-1.docker.io. PLIMSBY_CACHE_MAX sets the disk limit and defaults to 50GB; the oldest unused layers go first when the limit is hit. PLIMSBY_TTL sets how long manifests stay fresh and defaults to 6h. Basic auth turns on when both PLIMSBY_USER and PLIMSBY_PASSWORD are set. The health check calls GET /v2/ every 30 seconds. Set PLIMSBY_LOG_LEVEL to debug to log every cache miss.
